windows.name: Know The Mice for Windows
windows.description: Modern Liquid Glass installer with pure black aesthetic, auto-start, system tray host, firewall rules, and desktop shortcuts.
windows.changelog:
- Pure black Liquid Glass installer with desktop & start menu shortcuts
- High-performance Win32 input injector with stuck-key prevention
- Comprehensive system tray service with notifications
- Modern desktop dashboard layout

android.name: Know The Mice for Android
requirements: Connected to the same local Wi-Fi as your PC
android.description: Touchpad with multi-touch gestures, Gyroscope Air Mouse with complementary filter, full virtual keyboard, universal media deck, and presentation controls.
android.changelog:
- New safe-zone adaptive icon with zero clipping
- Full wireless mobile keyboard with QWERTY, F1-F12, and shortcuts
- AMOLED pure black canvas with tactile haptic controls
- 1-tap in-app Over-The-Air update installation
